evals.prompt: Threat-model a SaaS password-reset flow where support staff can impersonate customers, reset links pass through an email provider, and administrators can revoke sessions. We only have a prose architecture summary.
evals.expected_output: An assumption-aware threat model that maps assets, actors, data flows and trust boundaries; derives concrete abuse paths and STRIDE findings; and turns prioritized risks into owned, testable mitigations with residual-risk decisions.
assertions: Verified architecture facts and unresolved assumptions are recorded separately.
The model covers customer, support, administrator, email-provider, token, and session trust boundaries.
Each prioritized threat names an asset, actor, entry point, prerequisites, path, impact, and existing controls or gaps.
Mitigations include testable verification, an owner, residual risk, and acceptance authority.
